## The Soulless Totem Texture Pack

Transform your beacon of hope into a relic of the void. This pack replaces the standard golden Totem of Undying with the **Soulless Totem**—a pitch-black, pixel-accurate artifact featuring haunting, pale eyes that stare back from the darkness.

![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5565dc5d6d04ebae491d088f7789e4c9687e6b9e_0.webp)
---

Now, the **Soulless Totem** doesn't save your life by healing you; it saves you by momentarily pulling your essence into the void, making you a ghost that death simply cannot find.

[Soulless Totem](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/soulless-totem)
